maria: Heads-up — PR #8127 needs 2 approvals before 05:00 UTC cutoff. Small kv-cache warmup tweak that can change cold start behavior. Tagging @liam @olivia for second eyes. Can you take a quick look?
liam: On it, can you paste the failure you're seeing in prod or a short blurb? I might be in on-call but can eyeball.
maria: repro is intermittent. Failing on long sequences when warming KV. Added extra guard in runtime/kv_warmup.cc: ```diff
- if (!cache) return;
+ if (!cache || seq_len==0) return;
``` Also added unit and integration tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/8127
olivia: quick question — any perf hit from the extra check? Did you run a perf run on ci/staging?
maria: ran a 30min load on staging with the canary config.  p50 token latency +1ms, p95 unchanged. Smoke logs: ```
[staging-canary] tokens/sec: 1246 -> 1238
[staging-canary] p50: 39ms -> 40ms
```  No errors in 5k requests.
alex: if tests are green I can give an ok. liam, you good with the added check + test coverage?
liam: quick glance looks fine but can you add an assertion in the new unit test for seq_len==0 path? otherwise lgtm.
maria: added the assertion and pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/8127/files
devops-bot: CI pipeline: build ✓, unit tests ✓, integration tests ✓, smoke job queued
olivia: LGTM :+1: — good catch on the guard, thanks for tests.
liam: LGTM
maria: thanks everyone — merging now and kicking off canary. I’ll monitor for 30m and escalate if anything odd. :rocket:
devops-bot: Deploy queued to canary cluster (canary-3). Monitor link: https://ops.redwood.ai/monitor/canary-3
